title: Create the Gradle/Compose project skeleton with ktlint, lint and unit tests
description: Create the single-module Android app `:app` (Kotlin, Compose, Material 3) with pinned versions, a Gradle wrapper, ktlint, Android lint and a passing unit test, so every later task has a working verify command. Also creates the manual DI container and a navigation host with a placeholder home screen.
steps: `source scripts/env.sh`. Create `settings.gradle.kts` (rootProject.name = "ConvoScribe", include(":app"), pluginManagement repos google()/mavenCentral()/gradlePluginPortal(), dependencyResolutionManagement with `RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS`, repos google()/mavenCentral()). Then run `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.11.1 --distribution-type bin` in the repo root and commit `gradlew`, `gradlew.bat`, `gradle/wrapper/*`.

Create `gradle/libs.versions.toml` with exactly these versions: agp 8.7.3, kotlin 2.0.21, ksp 2.0.21-1.0.28, composeBom 2024.12.01, coreKtx 1.15.0, activityCompose 1.9.3, lifecycle 2.8.7, navigationCompose 2.8.5, room 2.6.1, okhttp 4.12.0, serializationJson 1.7.3, coroutines 1.9.0, securityCrypto 1.1.0-alpha06, junit 4.13.2, robolectric 4.14.1, androidxTestCore 1.6.1, turbine 1.2.0, ktlintPlugin 12.1.2. Declare libraries: androidx-core-ktx, androidx-activity-compose, androidx-lifecycle-runtime-ktx, androidx-lifecycle-viewmodel-compose, androidx-lifecycle-runtime-compose, androidx-lifecycle-service, androidx-navigation-compose, compose-bom, compose-ui, compose-ui-tooling-preview, compose-ui-tooling, compose-material3, compose-material-icons-core, room-runtime, room-ktx, room-compiler, room-testing, okhttp, okhttp-mockwebserver, kotlinx-serialization-json, kotlinx-coroutines-android, kotlinx-coroutines-test, androidx-security-crypto, junit, robolectric, androidx-test-core, turbine. Plugins: android-application, kotlin-android, kotlin-compose (`org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose`), kotlin-serialization, ksp (`com.google.devtools.ksp`), ktlint (`org.jlleitschuh.gradle.ktlint`).

`app/build.gradle.kts`: apply android-application, kotlin-android, kotlin-compose, kotlin-serialization, ksp, ktlint. `namespace = "com.convoscribe"`, applicationId same, compileSdk 35, minSdk 29, targetSdk 35, versionCode 1, versionName "0.1.0", Java/Kotlin target 17 (`kotlinOptions { jvmTarget = "17" }`), `buildFeatures { compose = true }`, `testOptions { unitTests.isIncludeAndroidResources = true }`, `lint { abortOnError = true; checkDependencies = false }`, release `isMinifyEnabled = false`. Add all the libraries above (debugImplementation for compose-ui-tooling, testImplementation for junit, robolectric, androidx-test-core, kotlinx-coroutines-test, turbine, okhttp-mockwebserver, room-testing; `ksp(libs.room.compiler)`).
Add `.editorconfig` at root: `[*.{kt,kts}]` with `ktlint_code_style = android_studio`, `ktlint_function_naming_ignore_when_annotated_with = Composable`, `max_line_length = 120`.

Create `AndroidManifest.xml` with `<application android:name=".ConvoApp" android:label="@string/app_name" android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher" android:theme="@style/Theme.ConvoScribe" android:largeHeap="true">` and a launcher `MainActivity` (exported=true). Add `res/values/strings.xml` (app_name = ConvoScribe), `res/values/themes.xml` (`Theme.ConvoScribe` parent `android:Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar`), and an adaptive launcher icon `res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml` using a vector `res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml` (108dp, viewport 108, a microphone: group translated by 42,42 containing pathData `M12,14c1.66,0 2.99,-1.34 2.99,-3L15,5c0,-1.66 -1.34,-3 -3,-3S9,3.34 9,5v6c0,1.66 1.34,3 3,3zM17.3,11c0,3 -2.54,5.1 -5.3,5.1S6.7,14 6.7,11L5,11c0,3.41 2.72,6.23 6,6.72L11,21h2v-3.28c3.28,-0.48 6,-3.3 6,-6.72h-1.7z` filled white) and background color `#FF3F51B5` in `res/values/colors.xml`. Only icons from `Icons.Filled.*`/`Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.*` in material-icons-core may be used anywhere in the app (e.g. Settings, Share, MoreVert, Delete, Add, Close, Check, Refresh, ArrowBack, Send); for anything else add a vector drawable.

Create `ConvoApp.kt` (`class ConvoApp : Application` with `lateinit var container: AppContainer` set in `onCreate`) and `AppContainer.kt` (`class AppContainer(val context: Context)` with a `val applicationScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)`; later tasks add fields).

Create `ui/theme/Theme.kt` (`ConvoScribeTheme` using `dynamicColorScheme` on API 31+, else `lightColorScheme()`/`darkColorScheme()`), `ui/AppNavHost.kt` with a `NavHost` whose start destination is route `home`, and `ui/home/HomeScreen.kt` showing a `Scaffold` with top bar title "ConvoScribe" and the text "No sessions yet". `MainActivity` calls `enableEdgeToEdge()` and `setContent { ConvoScribeTheme { AppNavHost() } }`.
Add `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/SmokeTest.kt` with one JUnit test asserting `1 + 1 == 2` (proves the test runner works).

Create `README.md`: one paragraph on the app, then Build: `bash scripts/setup-toolchain.sh`, `source scripts/env.sh`, the verify command, and how to install: `adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`.
Run the verify command and fix all problems.
acceptanceCriteria: `gradle/libs.versions.toml` contains exactly the versions listed in the steps
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: If `lintDebug` reports errors for template issues (e.g. missing icon densities), fix the cause rather than disabling checks; disabling a single check in `lint {}` with a comment is allowed only for `GradleDependency`, `NewerVersionAvailable`, `OldTargetApi` and `AndroidGradlePluginVersion` (we pin versions on purpose). | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` classes in unit tests and only reference them inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
